name: kling-ai
description: Create and manage Kling AI image, video, motion, and reusable Element workflows through an OAuth-protected remote MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Create images and videos from text or reference media, use motion control and reusable Elements, upload source assets, check credits, and track tasks. OAuth is managed by the host, and a clear generation request authorizes one submission without another confirmation; failed submissions are never retried automatically.
defaultPrompt: Draw a red panda in a vintage spacesuit floating by a space station window, lit by Earth’s blue glow, cinematic and detailed
Use Kling 4.0 to create a 5-second cinematic video: a mecha crashes down, blasting rubble as the camera rushes in.
Use Kling 4.0 to create a 15-second sneaker ad: street action, product close-ups, and a detailed final hero shot.
